_comment: Frame 6, one per scent, genuinely different content per scent. Re-uploaded 2026-08-01 after config/ingredients.json was corrected — the emulsifying wax is certified organic and the cream's grapefruit seed extract is the organic one. The live frames printed the old wording, which is exactly the drift the renderer exists to fix: correct the source, re-render, re-upload.
